An OData CRUD Post action must return 201 Created with the created representation.

What the Standard says

RFC 9110 defines the HTTP semantics that apply to this response path. read it here.

Why it matters

Enforcing this rule gives callers and maintainers one predictable contract and makes drift visible during the build. The analyser proves this specific source-level condition; it does not replace runtime acceptance or security testing.

Bad code example

// Violates RFC0001
return Ok(createdStudent);

Good code example

// Follows RFC0001
return Created(createdStudent);
